notes.title: fix minor resolution bug
notes.notes: [p]Users with resolutions higher than 1920 x 1080 had gameplay issues.[/p][p]So, set the resolution to 1920 x 1080 for all users.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
- The bucket painting system was added.
- Kit cards now have greater flexibility when storing them off-screen.
- Now when painting with the airbrush, the diameter of the painting area can be modified.
- The kit card storage area has been moved to the left.
- the workspace was minimally increased.
- Added the function to automatically switch between scissors and gloves by pressing the right mouse button.
